title: Repository governance
scope_or_key_finding: Defines repository-wide authority and no-parallel-kernel constraints.
limitations: Repository policy, not empirical model evidence.

title: CPCS architecture
scope_or_key_finding: Defines one provider-neutral score and compile-render-verify-repair loop.
limitations: Architecture may exceed currently qualified runtime behavior.

title: Lab governance
scope_or_key_finding: Requires controlled A/B experiments and exact authority boundaries.
limitations: Policy only.

title: CPCS control surface
scope_or_key_finding: Maps authored prose, canonical controls, and known unexplored areas.
limitations: Several statements are research hypotheses pending verification.

title: CPCS format control map
scope_or_key_finding: Defines YAML authoring, JSON canonical authority, XML event envelopes, JSONL evidence, and media controls.
limitations: Does not prove provider-side structured-format superiority.

title: Universal score schema 1.0
scope_or_key_finding: Existing owners include entities, scenes, shots, beats, actions, interactions, camera, editing, audio, continuity, constraints, provider realization, verification requirements, and loss surfaces.
limitations: Many high-level objects are open objects and need typed minimal extensions.

title: Provider capability schema 1.0
scope_or_key_finding: Current schema is hard-coded to Google Vertex AI Veo 3.1 and its current adapter assumptions.
limitations: Not yet a universal multi-provider capability contract.

title: Verification plan schema 1.0
scope_or_key_finding: Supports direct, semantic, measured, and human-review observability plus provider artifact checks.
limitations: Current artifact checks are basic media properties; failure-specific metrics require extension.

title: Compliance report schema 1.0
scope_or_key_finding: Already supports evidence traces, conflicts, interval-scoped failures, and bounded repair actions that reassert canonical controls.
limitations: Does not yet define the failure taxonomy or metric catalog in this package.

title: Second-brain governance
scope_or_key_finding: Separates frozen research, curated knowledge, immutable evidence, and rebuildable derived state.
limitations: Research proposals cannot promote themselves into production authority.

title: Generate videos with Veo using first and last frames
scope_or_key_finding: Veo 3.1 supports first/last frame conditioning, 4/6/8-second outputs, 720p/1080p, optional negative prompt, and seed in the documented endpoint.
limitations: Capability documentation does not establish adherence reliability.

title: Runway API reference
scope_or_key_finding: Documents text-, image-, and video-conditioned endpoints, model identifiers, prompt strings, ratios, durations, seeds, and reference assets.
limitations: Runway can expose third-party models; adapter behavior may differ from original providers.

title: Runway API changelog
scope_or_key_finding: Version-scopes Gen-4.5, Seedance 2.0, Veo 3.1, Aleph 2.0, and related API controls.
limitations: Changelog is interface evidence, not quality evidence.

title: Seedance 2.0 official launch
scope_or_key_finding: Documents unified text/image/audio/video inputs, up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips, and up to 15-second multi-shot audio-video output.
limitations: Internal benchmark and marketing claims are not independent reliability evidence.

title: Kling VIDEO 3.0 model user guide
scope_or_key_finding: Documents T2V, I2V, first/last frames, native audio, multi-shot, element references, and flexible 3-15 second generation.
limitations: Official guide contains promotional quality statements; only interface claims are used as capability evidence.

title: MiniMax API release notes
scope_or_key_finding: Hailuo-2.3 supports T2V and I2V; Hailuo-2.3-Fast supports I2V; documented 768p 6/10s and 1080p 6s outputs.
limitations: No independent failure-rate evidence.

title: MiniMax text-to-video API
scope_or_key_finding: Prompt is a text string up to 2000 characters; documented bracketed camera commands provide a provider-specific syntax.
limitations: Camera command support does not guarantee exact choreography.

title: LTX-Video/LTX-2 official repository
scope_or_key_finding: Documents synchronized audio-video, multiple keyframes, video extension, video-to-video, control models, and up to 10-second LTX-2 outputs.
limitations: Repository claims and demos are not independent reliability measurements.

title: Wan2.2 official repository
scope_or_key_finding: Documents T2V, I2V, unified TI2V, speech-to-video, pose-video control, character animation/replacement, 480p/720p workflows, and seeds through local inference.
limitations: Open-model performance depends on checkpoint, sampler, hardware, and configuration.

title: HunyuanVideo-1.5 official repository
scope_or_key_finding: Documents 8.3B T2V/I2V models, 480p/720p generation, super-resolution, prompt rewriting, seed control, and compressed spatiotemporal latent architecture.
limitations: Official evaluation is model-authored and not a substitute for CPCS qualification.

title: CogVideo/CogVideoX official repository
scope_or_key_finding: Documents CogVideoX1.5 T2V/I2V, 10-second generation, resolutions, frames, and local seed-based inference.
limitations: Current commercial QingYing behavior is outside the open repository scope.

title: Mochi 1 official repository
scope_or_key_finding: Documents a 10B AsymmDiT and a 128x-compressed causal video latent representation for open T2V generation.
limitations: Repository preview does not document all hosted product controls or current service limits.

title: Veo 3.1 model documentation
scope_or_key_finding: Documents Veo 3.1 model IDs, modes, resolutions, durations, and endpoint-specific capability differences.
limitations: Google pages expose conflicting or endpoint-specific sound/reference statements; package marks audio capability as requiring endpoint verification.

title: VBench/VBench++/VBench-2.0
scope_or_key_finding: Fine-grained evaluation dimensions include subject/background consistency, temporal flicker, motion smoothness, multiple objects, spatial relations, and semantics; human-alignment annotations are provided.
limitations: Aggregate metrics can hide localized failures and inherit evaluator biases.

title: T2V-CompBench
scope_or_key_finding: Benchmarks attribute binding, spatial relationships, motion/action binding, object interactions, and generative numeracy; reports compositional generation remains highly challenging.
limitations: Primarily T2V and benchmark-prompt scoped; commercial model versions age quickly.

title: TC-Bench
scope_or_key_finding: Evaluates temporal compositionality using explicit initial/final states and transition completeness; metrics correlate more strongly with humans than prior metrics in the study.
limitations: Does not directly isolate every production failure type.

title: VideoPhy-2
scope_or_key_finding: On the hard subset, the best evaluated model achieved 22% joint semantic-and-physical adherence; conservation of mass and momentum were particularly difficult.
limitations: Results apply to evaluated versions and prompts, not every current provider release.

title: PhyGenBench
scope_or_key_finding: 160 prompts cover 27 physical laws; authors report current models struggle and prompt engineering alone is insufficient for dynamic physical phenomena.
limitations: Automated hierarchical evaluation still needs human calibration.

title: WorldModelBench
scope_or_key_finding: Evaluates instruction following, common sense, and physical adherence over 350 prompts and seven application domains with a human-aligned VLM judge.
limitations: Judge-based results inherit the judge's model and training distribution.

title: Physics-IQ Verified
scope_or_key_finding: Audits Physics-IQ, revises prompts/ground truth, and reports meaningful ranking changes, demonstrating benchmark construction can materially alter conclusions.
limitations: Recent preprint; not yet peer reviewed at access date.

title: VideoScore
scope_or_key_finding: Uses 37.6K human-scored generated videos; reports strong but imperfect human correlation, supporting learned evaluators as proxies rather than authorities.
limitations: Domain shift, fast events, and unseen artifact classes remain risks.

title: EvalCrafter
scope_or_key_finding: Combines 17 objective metrics and human feedback across visual, content, motion, temporal consistency, and alignment dimensions.
limitations: Multiple metrics do not eliminate correlated evaluator failure.

title: ChronoMagic-Bench
scope_or_key_finding: Evaluates metamorphic progression and temporal coherence over long visual transformations.
limitations: Time-lapse focus does not directly cover all interaction/contact failures.

title: WorldBench: How Close are World Models to the Physical World?
scope_or_key_finding: Reports degradation with prediction horizon and identifies object permanence as the hardest scenario in its benchmark.
limitations: Synthetic/controlled benchmark; title-level results should not be generalized to every commercial model.

title: Temporally Consistent Transformers for Video Generation
scope_or_key_finding: Documents that models can invent different content when a scene leaves view and is revisited; introduces long-range consistency datasets and TECO.
limitations: Video prediction setting differs from prompt-only commercial generation but exposes the same hidden-state problem.

title: Tracking through Containers and Occluders in the Wild
scope_or_key_finding: Defines object-permanence tracking under heavy occlusion/containment and finds a substantial remaining performance gap.
limitations: Perception benchmark, not a generator benchmark; used to design verification and visibility bridges.

title: MemoBench
scope_or_key_finding: Tests disappear-and-reappear memory while hidden objects continue changing state.
limitations: Recent preprint; version and leaderboard may change.

title: EntityBench
scope_or_key_finding: Tracks characters, objects, and locations across up to 50 shots; reports consistency degradation with recurrence distance and benefit from explicit entity memory.
limitations: Recent preprint; multi-shot systems and metrics may evolve.

title: GeCo
scope_or_key_finding: Introduces dense geometry-grounded maps for deformation and occlusion inconsistency and uses them as a training-free guidance signal.
limitations: Static-scene emphasis and learned depth/motion priors limit universal coverage.

title: TOC-Bench
scope_or_key_finding: Shows video-LLMs remain weak on object identity, state, event ordering, and hallucination-aware verification across occlusion and reappearance.
limitations: Evaluates video understanding, not generation; directly informs evaluator-risk controls.

title: SAM 2
scope_or_key_finding: Promptable video segmentation with streaming memory; suitable for masks, counts, and continuity traces.
limitations: Segmentation errors under blur, reflections, occlusion, small subjects, and stylized content must be calibrated.

title: CoTracker3
scope_or_key_finding: Tracks visible and occluded points and supports long trajectories.
limitations: Tracking can swap identities or lose points in severe occlusion, cuts, deformation, and out-of-distribution imagery.

title: TAPIR
scope_or_key_finding: Tracks arbitrary points with per-frame matching and temporal refinement.
limitations: Point tracking is not semantic identity proof and can fail on textureless/blurred/occluded surfaces.

title: RAFT
scope_or_key_finding: Dense optical flow supports foot slip, motion continuity, and camera/actor decomposition diagnostics.
limitations: Known difficult cases include fast motion, occlusion, motion blur, and textureless regions.

title: AV-SyncBench
scope_or_key_finding: Separates temporal from semantic audio-visual synchronization across voice, music, and sound events.
limitations: Very recent preprint; model rankings and code may change.

title: VABench
scope_or_key_finding: Evaluates text-video, text-audio, video-audio, synchronization, lip-speech consistency, and audio/video QA for joint generation.
limitations: Preprint and benchmark design require independent reproduction.

title: AV-HuBERT
scope_or_key_finding: Provides audio-visual speech representations useful for lip-speech agreement checks.
limitations: Speech recognition quality is not identical to generative lip-sync quality; model is archived and domain-limited.

title: PhyGround
scope_or_key_finding: Uses criteria-grounded physical-law questions and reports evaluator bias differences, supporting auditable, law-specific and human-calibrated scoring.
limitations: Recent preprint; requires independent reproduction.

title: CRONOS
scope_or_key_finding: Uses controlled counterfactual interventions for falls, collisions, and full occlusion/reappearance.
limitations: Controlled simulated setting may not predict cinematic model behavior exactly.

title: Video generation and editing model overview
scope_or_key_finding: Version-scopes Wan 2.7 text, image, reference, editing, audio, duration, resolution, frame rate, and character animation interfaces.
limitations: Capability documentation does not establish continuity or physics reliability.

title: Available AI models and API reference
scope_or_key_finding: Current Runway API exposes gen4.5, aleph2, Seedance 2 variants, Veo variants, and other models with endpoint-specific inputs.
limitations: Runway-hosted third-party behavior may differ from native-provider interfaces.

title: Creating with Edit Studio (Aleph 2.0)
scope_or_key_finding: Documents source-video editing and localized transformations over single- or multi-shot input up to 30 seconds.
limitations: Product documentation describes available operations, not exact edit isolation rates.

title: Ray 3.2 introduction and core concepts
scope_or_key_finding: Clarifies Ray 3.2 is source-video modify, not text-to-video, image animation, or extension; supports dense keyframe anchoring and source-duration preservation.
limitations: Product documentation does not establish perfect source preservation.

title: Sora 2 System Card
scope_or_key_finding: Documents Sora 2 video/audio claims and states that the consumer Sora product is no longer available as of 2026-04-26.
limitations: No current public production interface was verified in this research pass.

title: Kling AI launches 3.0
scope_or_key_finding: Documents Kling Video 3.0 and Video 3.0 Omni with text, image, audio, and video inputs, native audio, reference/editing tasks, and up to 15-second output.
limitations: Quality and consistency language is provider-authored and not independent reliability evidence.

title: MiniMax API overview
scope_or_key_finding: Lists current video models and text, first-frame, last-frame, and reference-image inputs.
limitations: Exact features vary by model and endpoint.

title: Runway API input parameters
scope_or_key_finding: Documents current aspect-ratio rules and that Aleph 2.0 preserves source resolution up to 1080p for 2-30 second inputs at 30 fps or lower.
limitations: Resolution preservation is not semantic-state preservation.

title: Gen-4.5 API changelog entry
scope_or_key_finding: Documents Gen-4.5 text-to-video and image-to-video with 2-10 second durations.
limitations: No official failure distribution is provided.

title: Gen-3 Alpha prompting guide
scope_or_key_finding: Historically advises positive phrasing instead of negative phrasing for Gen-3.
limitations: This is deprecated-model guidance and must not be generalized to all providers.

title: Wan 2.7 image-to-video API
scope_or_key_finding: Documents first-frame, first/last-frame, video continuation, multimodal input, and region-bound endpoint behavior.
limitations: Endpoint behavior and regional model aliases can change.

title: Wan reference-to-video API
scope_or_key_finding: Documents reference inputs, durations, prompt rewriting, seeds, and explicitly states that identical seeds do not guarantee identical output.
limitations: Native provider behavior only; hosted adapters may expose different parameters.

title: WorldReasonBench
scope_or_key_finding: 436 cases across physical, social, logical, and informational state evolution expose a gap between visual plausibility and dynamics, causality, or information preservation.
limitations: Recent preprint; commercial model versions and rankings can change.

title: MBench
scope_or_key_finding: Decomposes video-world-model memory into entity, environment, and causal consistency and reports systemic long-term state-retention limits.
limitations: Recent preprint and long-horizon scope; not all short commercial clips are represented.

title: TimeBlind
scope_or_key_finding: Minimal temporal pairs show the strongest evaluated MLLM at 48.2% instance accuracy versus 98.2% human performance.
limitations: Evaluates understanding models rather than generators; informs verifier calibration.

title: SLVMEval
scope_or_key_finding: Synthetic degradations show evaluation systems below human accuracy in nine of ten long-video quality aspects.
limitations: Long-video focus; individual evaluator versions may improve.

title: Towards Understanding Camera Motions in Any Video (CameraBench)
scope_or_key_finding: Shows semantic and geometric camera-motion estimators have complementary blind spots; zoom and forward translation can be confused without training.
limitations: Camera understanding benchmark, not a direct generator benchmark.

title: HumanScore
scope_or_key_finding: Six interpretable human-motion metrics identify temporal jitter, anatomically implausible poses, and motion drift across 13 models.
limitations: Recent preprint; pose and biomechanics estimates remain model-dependent.

title: ETVA
scope_or_key_finding: Uses prompt scene graphs and atomic questions; reports 58.47 Spearman correlation with human judgment for alignment.
limitations: Correlation is not perfect; atomic QA can still miss fast or ambiguous events.

title: VideoScore2
scope_or_key_finding: Reports around 50% average accuracy on four out-of-domain benchmarks despite improved multi-dimensional reasoning.
limitations: Evaluator performance and benchmark composition may change after publication.

title: MotionCtrl
scope_or_key_finding: Separates camera motion from object motion using camera poses and trajectories.
limitations: Model-specific research method; does not prove current commercial support.

title: DragNUWA
scope_or_key_finding: Combines text, image, and trajectory conditions for spatial and temporal control.
limitations: Open research method with its own training and domain limits.

title: CameraCtrl
scope_or_key_finding: Uses explicit camera trajectories for precise camera-pose control.
limitations: Requires a compatible trained module; ordinary text prompts do not gain this control automatically.

title: C-Drag
scope_or_key_finding: Adds reasoning about surrounding-object effects because a controlled object's trajectory alone does not specify interaction consequences.
limitations: VLM reasoning and trajectory prediction can fail; not a universal physics solver.

title: GenMAC
scope_or_key_finding: Iterates design, generation, verification, correction, and structured redesign for compositional video generation.
limitations: Agent judgments and repeated generation add cost and can propagate evaluator errors.

title: VideoDirectorGPT
scope_or_key_finding: Plans scenes, entity layouts, backgrounds, and consistency groups before grounded generation.
limitations: Research framework and backbone-specific results; not a current provider guarantee.

title: VideoTetris
scope_or_key_finding: Uses spatiotemporal compositional attention for multiple objects and changing object counts.
limitations: Requires model-level intervention rather than prompt-only access.

title: VBench
scope_or_key_finding: Defines 16 dimensions including identity consistency, motion smoothness, flicker, and spatial relationship with human annotations.
limitations: Dimension scores can miss localized causal failures.

title: T2V-CompBench paper
scope_or_key_finding: Covers attribute, action, motion, spatial, interaction, and count binding over a large compositional prompt set.
limitations: Benchmark results are model-version scoped.

title: VideoPhy-2 paper
scope_or_key_finding: Reports only 22% joint success for the best evaluated model on the hard subset and difficulty with mass and momentum.
limitations: Applies to tested models and prompts; not a current universal score.

title: PhyGenBench paper
scope_or_key_finding: Covers 160 prompts and 27 physical laws and reports that scaling and prompt engineering alone do not solve dynamic physical failures.
limitations: Automated evaluator and prompt set have finite coverage.

title: AV-SyncBench
scope_or_key_finding: Separates temporal offset detection from semantic audio-video matching over 3,269 videos and 38,390 samples.
limitations: Very recent preprint; exact leaderboard status may change.
